name: Baldur
one_liner: Generates whole-function Isabelle/HOL proofs and uses the prover error message to repair broken proofs.

loop.proposes: A language model generates a complete Isabelle/HOL proof script for a target theorem.
loop.judged_by: The Isabelle proof assistant executes the script and returns an error message when the proof fails.
loop.steers: A repair model conditions on the statement, the whole failed proof and the Isabelle error message to synthesize a corrected proof.

headline_result: Proved 47.9% of theorems in the Isabelle Archive of Formal Proofs benchmark (65.7% when combined with Thor Sledgehammer).
caveat: Single-round error repair struggles on deep multi-lemma obligations where the initial proof sketch chooses the wrong induction variable.
beyond_harness_note: The Isabelle/HOL kernel acts as the formal oracle whose error messages drive whole-proof synthesis and repair.
generative_model: Minerva-based proof generation and repair LLMs
algorithmic_authority: Isabelle/HOL proof assistant and Sledgehammer ATP

sources.title: Baldur: Whole-Proof Generation and Repair with Large Language Models (ESEC/FSE 2023)

verification.notes: Checked against First et al., ESEC/FSE 2023.
